While this is a laboratory procedure limitation, it may also further support the use of OAT for craving management. The study's small sample size and balance between males/females.

* Single center RCT
* Individual effects of each component of CDA in decreasing IRI were not assessed separately.

* Although the study was powered to detect differences in peak AST, the small sample size did not allow a claim on the absence of an effect.

Variations in fracture patterns and size led to potential inconsistencies in antibiotic powder administration and swabbing techniques (e.g., skin flora contamination). Future studies require larger cohorts to confirm the efficacy of local antibiotic powder in orthopedic trauma.

Some clinical endpoints trial might have been affected by observer bias, availability of hospital or ICU resources, and/or hospital discharge. Missing ABG measurements may have resulted from decreased standard utilization of ABG in recent years, and hospital staff overload due to the COVID-19 pandemic may have led to absent follow-up assessment.
